OpenBareMap Scotland 2.0.0

Copy OpenBareMap-Scotland.img into the Garmin folder on your device or memory card, then enable OpenBareMap Scotland. This edition has its own reserved family ID and can coexist with the other OpenBareMap editions. Display-only: no turn-by-turn routing. Use metres for contour labels.

Device rendering has not yet been reviewed.

Attribution: https://downloads.appsbyonzy.dev/Garmin/scotland/ATTRIBUTION.txt
Elevation sources: https://downloads.appsbyonzy.dev/Garmin/scotland/terrain-data-sources.md
Elevation attribution: https://downloads.appsbyonzy.dev/Garmin/scotland/terrain-attribution.md
